job.job_description:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer

Experience: 2-5 Years
Location: Pune (WFO)
Employment Type: Full-time




About HeapTrace Technology

HeapTrace Technology is looking for passionate Full Stack Engineers to join our growing delivery team in Pune. We are looking for developers who enjoy building end-to-end applications, collaborating directly with clients, and taking ownership of the complete software development lifecycle.
If you're enthusiastic about modern technologies, cloud platforms, and AI-assisted development, we'd love to hear from you.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack web applications.
Build features across frontend, backend, database, and cloud environments.
Participate in requirement gathering and client discussions.
Develop clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
Perform code reviews and follow development best practices.
Write unit/integration tests and ensure application quality.
Deploy applications and support CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Work with AI-powered development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to improve productivity while maintaining code quality.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in at least one Frontend technology: React.js, Next.js, or Angular.
Proficiency in at least one Backend technology: Java, Node.js, or Python (Django).
Good understanding of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Experience in designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Strong knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
Hands-on experience with Git and version control practices.
Exposure to Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is an added advantage.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
Good understanding of software design principles, debugging, and performance optimization.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to interact directly with clients and understand business requirements.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code for development and testing is preferred.



Required Qualifications

2-5 years of hands-on experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong knowledge of one Frontend framework and one Backend technology.
Experience with relational or NoSQL databases.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Good understanding of software development best practices.
Strong communication skills and ability to interact with clients.
Experience owning features from development to deployment.



Why Join HeapTrace?

Direct client interaction and ownership of projects.
Opportunity to work on modern technologies and AI-assisted development.
Collaborative engineering culture.
Career growth into senior engineering and leadership roles.
Challenging and impactful projects.
